description: This file contains functions and logic for generating HTML reports for LLM autocompletion test cases, including loading approvals, formatting content, and creating index and detail pages.

classes.name: ApprovalFile
classes.description: Interface representing an approval or rejection file with filename, type, number, and content.

classes.name: ParsedApprovalContent
classes.description: Interface representing parsed parts of approval content: prefix, completion, and suffix.

classes.name: TestCaseWithApprovals
classes.description: Extends TestCase to include an array of ApprovalFile objects.

methods.name: parseApprovalContent
methods.description: Extracts prefix, completion, and suffix from approval content based on cursor position.

methods.name: formatApprovalContent
methods.description: Formats approval content into HTML with highlighted completion and greyed context parts.

methods.name: loadApprovals
methods.description: Loads approval and rejection files for a given test case category and name.

methods.name: escapeHtml
methods.description: Escapes special HTML characters in a string.

methods.name: highlightCursor
methods.description: Highlights the cursor position in the input text for display.

methods.name: generateIndexHtml
methods.description: Generates the main index HTML page listing all test cases categorized.

methods.name: generateTestCaseHtml
methods.description: Generates detailed HTML page for a specific test case, including approvals, context files, and navigation.

methods.name: generateHtmlReport
methods.description: Main function to generate the entire HTML report, including index and individual test case pages.
